title: Critical GJMS Equations on $\mathbb{H}^n \times \mathbb{S}^m$
summary: Let $M=\mathbb{H}^n\times\mathbb{S}^m$, where $n\geq 2$, $m\geq 1$, and $N=n+m$. Let $P_k$ be the order-$2k$ GJMS operator, with $1\leq k 0$. We study$$P_kU-λU=|U|^{q-2}U,\qquad q=\frac{2N}{N-2k},\qquad 0 Λ_{\mathrm{loc}}$, where $Λ_{\mathrm{loc}}$ is explicit. If $N\geq2k+2$ and $S_{Λ_0,k}(M)<S_{N,k}$, attainment also holds at $λ=Λ_0$ in the threshold form completion. At the threshold, $L^2$-coercivity fails precisely on the constant spherical eigenspace.
